description: Manage client testimonials with ratings, customer details, and admin display.
dataStorage: Custom post type 'tmnl_testimonial' with post_meta fields: tmnl_rating (int 1-5), tmnl_customer_name (text), tmnl_customer_company (text, optional). Title and editor content store testimonial text.
securityRequirements: ABSPATH guard in all PHP files
Meta box save protected with wp_verify_nonce and current_user_can capability check
All inputs sanitized: absint for rating (clamped 1-5), sanitize_text_field for customer name/company
All output escaped with esc_html in admin columns
No eval, no arbitrary file inclusion, no @ error suppression
uninstall.php with WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN guard for data cleanup
